mark_window: 43201 completed minute close endpoints from t-30DAY through t inclusive. All real, finite, positive, exact continuous grid. Current completed close t is known at signal time.
execution_gap: G(v)=log(TradeOpen(v)/P(v)), v in [t-30DAY,t-MIN], v+MIN<=t. P(v) is previous minute close, strictly before modeled fill v+1us. g_up=max(0,max(G)); g_down=min(0,min(G)).
trigger: q!=0 and original account not halted and window READY and E+q*(P_s-P(t)) <= abs(q)*P_s*.005 + abs(q)*abs(fill_s-P_s) + abs(q)*fill_s*.00055
not_ready: No shorter window, insertion, interpolation, new source, derived/unknown mark, duplicate or missing minute. Preserve original path and report reason, symbol, time coverage.
latency: First eligible real open t+MIN modeled at t+MIN+1us; fifth at t+5MIN+1us. No open t execution.
capacity_witness: Posterior only. Freeze trigger q; five real opens with previous completed minute quote_volume*.001/current trade open; floor quantity to 1e-8 and share each symbol/open bucket across all legs. Real open times, spread4bp+slip4bp per side and fee5.5bp on actual fill. Never feed future capacity or price into trigger.
limits: Historical maxima are a conservative empirical buffer, not a future-risk bound. Funding, future gaps, mark rules and capacity can still defeat it. Shadow does not modify original q/E/cash/cost/target path. No new PnL, wallet, fits or downloading.
2024: Only 461448 successful original account minutes; halt witness separate. Source after halt is posterior price/capacity evidence only, not recovered positions.
